name: paperlint
description: Check and finish scientific papers with Claude Code. Finds undefined terms, inconsistent notation, numbers that do not match their data, overstated claims and incomplete derivations, and fixes them with minimal edits. Drafts prose from real paragraphs of a house-style corpus (J. Marino, H. Hosseinabadi, M. Stefanini) and from the authors' own edits, and measures it with a blind human-vs-generated test.
